title: Effect of Retrieval Practice, Summarization and Restudy on Text Retention and Text Comprehension in Primary Education
descriptions: This file contains data on the effects of retrieval practice and summarization on text retention and text comprehension (restudy control condition). Also data on the improvement on the retention during retrieval practice sessions is available, and data on the improvement of the qualaty of the summaries during the three practice sessions.
